ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

22. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Smell ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
